records.name: Wittenburg Handyman Service
records.providerEvidence: The official branded site identifies owner-operator Dulyn Wittenburg and directly offers kitchens, tile, carpentry and screen-room construction among its completed home projects.
records.customerEvidence: The official site repeatedly addresses homeowners and documents completed residential kitchen, bathroom, sliding-door and screen-room projects.
records.geographicEvidence: The official service-area section explicitly names Panama City Beach, and its project gallery identifies completed residential work in Panama City Beach.
records.identityEvidence: The official site identifies Dulyn Wittenburg as owner and operator since 2001 and publishes telephone 850-260-4578 and a company email address.
records.evidenceNote: Locally owned, owner-operated Bay County contractor whose official site documents residential kitchen, bathroom and screen-room work and explicitly names Panama City Beach.
records.duplicateCheck: Normalized name, telephone and wittenburghandyman.com were absent from all 14,295 run-start baseline placements.

records.name: NAILED IT! Handyman Services of Panama City

records.customerEvidence: The site describes household to-do lists, home repairs and vacation-home services and offers the listed outdoor work directly to residential property owners.
records.geographicEvidence: The official site identifies Panama City as the business location and expressly says its vacation-home and maintenance services cover the Panama City and Panama City Beach area.
records.identityEvidence: The official site identifies NAILED IT! Handyman Services of Panama City and publishes telephone 850-890-8940 and naileditpc@gmail.com.
records.evidenceNote: Local Panama City provider whose official site directly offers homeowner landscaping and fence installation or repair and expressly covers the Panama City Beach area.
records.duplicateCheck: Normalized name, telephone and naileditpc.com were absent from all 14,295 run-start baseline placements.

records.name: My Bay Services
records.providerEvidence: The official site identifies My Bay Services and directly offers irrigation repair, landscaping, residential remodeling and fencing through its own service departments.
records.customerEvidence: The official pages describe broken sprinkler heads, homeowner landscapes, kitchens, bathrooms and family fencing projects and offer those services directly to homes.
records.geographicEvidence: The official home page says the company provides the listed services throughout Bay County; Panama City and Panama City Beach are both municipalities within Bay County.
records.identityEvidence: The official contact page identifies My Bay Services at 11813 Camelia Street in Fountain, Florida and publishes telephone 850-753-5014 and Office@MyBayServices.com.
records.evidenceNote: Fountain-based direct provider whose official site offers residential irrigation repair, landscaping, kitchen and bath remodeling and fencing throughout Bay County, covering both target cities.
records.duplicateCheck: Normalized name, telephone and mybayservices.com were absent from all 14,295 run-start baseline placements.
